title: Private Escape Minutes From Downtown
description:
Enjoy Nashville with comfort and convenience in my guest house, which is a short walk from Nashville's finest restaurants and coffee shops, 2.5 miles to Broadway and 1.5 mile to Nissan Stadium! You'll have your own private entrance & garden seating area, a full size king bedroom, full kitchen, laundry, two living areas, and a huuuge upstairs sofa that pulls out into a queen bed. Whether you're grilling out, jammin out, or resting between Honky Tonks, you'll be covered and comfortable here :)

The space
Walk inside, and you'll be greeted by Dolly, soaring ceilings crowned by a crystal Chandelier, and all the comforts of home. 

The main living area is lined with art from local artists and has a couch for lounging, a dining table for four, counter seating, and a full kitchen. My kitchen is fully stocked with all needed cookware, a Nespresso coffee maker, tea kettle, microwave, utensils, dishes, and drinking glasses for any and every occasion worth celebrating!

The primary bedroom has a super comfy king bed with a Helix mattress, a 55" smart tv, touch lights with charging ports, and blackout curtains / blinds for those slow mornings after Broadway. The closet contains way too many extra linens, pillows, a steamer (for your clothes) and a laundry hamper.

The bathroom is in the hallway and has a rainfall shower with detachable wand and super soft towels. Across from the bathroom is the laundry closet, which contains a full size washer & dryer. Dryer sheets and detergent are just to the left of the refrigerator on the green rack. Lastly, feel free to use the thermostat to the left of the laundry closet to make your stay as comfortable as possible.

Upstairs is the media room, which has a West Elm sectional that pulls out into a very comfortable queen size bed. The 65" smart tv can access all streaming apps and is connected to a Sonos sound bar. Below the tv, you can find games and books. In the corner of the room, we also have a dedicated work station with an adjustable / standing desk!

Guest access
Park right out front and walk in to your private yard, with a beautiful garden, seating area, and propane grill! This space is totally private and ALL YOURS and you'll have no problems getting in or out.

Other things to note
I hope you'll explore our neighborhood and sign my guest book before you leave. East Nashville is a paradise for foodies and music lovers, and you're going to meet some fun people. Feel free to reach out to us or check out the guest manual on the dining table for a long list of recommendations on where to eat and things to do in Music City!
